name: James
bio: James, one of Jesus's brothers along with Joses, Simon, and Judas, is named by the skeptical people of Nazareth who took offense at Jesus's teaching despite knowing his humble family (Matthew 13:55-57). He is a different figure from the apostles James son of Zebedee and James son of Alphaeus; his later leadership of the Jerusalem church and authorship of the Epistle of James are told in the books ahead.
